— Mission Procedure

How it Works

Four steps to get your app authenticated

01

Register Your App

Create an account and register your application. Provide basic information about your app and configure your redirect URIs.

02

Get Credentials

Receive your Client ID and Client Secret. Use these to authenticate your application and request tokens securely.

03

Implement Authorization

Use the OIDC authorization flow to handle user login. Redirect users to our authorization endpoint and handle callbacks.

04

Exchange for Tokens

Exchange authorization codes for access and ID tokens. Securely store tokens and use them to access protected resources.
